parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query.

parameters.name: liteTopicName
parameters.description: The name of the lightweight topic.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: scrollId
parameters.description:
The scroll ID.

Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent paged queries, set this parameter to the scroll ID returned in the previous response.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query.
